info.name: Petyard - Assistant embedding charge review
info.description: Local contract template; not executed or published. All requests skip by default. SuperAdmin-only review of saved financial evidence. Read AI_ASSISTANT_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT.md. charge_reserved consumes the saved microUSD allowance; it is not a confirmed provider invoice or customer payment. No paid retry, source activation or chat unlock.

exec: pm.test('Private response is not cached', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

request.description: Only reserved dispatching/uncertain receipts, newest ObjectId first. Copy an intentionally chosen id to reviewBatchId; no automatic selection. For the next page add before=<nextBefore>. Listed active requests can have canReconcile=false.

exec: pm.test('Queue is bounded and includes its cursor', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.batches).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.batches.length).to.be.at.most(20); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('nextBefore'); });

request.description: Use the queue's id unchanged. Inspect kind/owner, providerRequestId, state and reservedMicroUsd. Divide microUSD by 1,000,000 to display USD; this is never EGP. Closing an uncertain charge keeps its full reservation as a conservative expense, without changing source approval or customer chat.

exec: pm.test('Receipt identity and eligibility are explicit', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const row = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(row.id).to.eql(String(pm.variables.get('reviewBatchId')).toLowerCase()); pm.expect(row.canReconcile).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(row.reservedMicroUsd).to.be.a('number'); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const row = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('lastReviewedBatchId', row.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('lastReviewCanReconcile', String(row.canReconcile)); }

request.description: Financial mutation. GET this receipt first; review the reserved amount and enter reviewReason. Then explicitly set the COLLECTION variable confirmEmbeddingReview=true. The script resets it before sending; environment overrides cannot confirm. Server rechecks state/authority. After timeout GET the same receipt: charged_reservation with reconciliation records success; reserved stays unresolved. Repeating that same closed receipt is idempotent and preserves the first actor/reason. No Idempotency-Key header is required. Never select another receipt to recover a lost response.

exec: if (!approved || pm.collectionVariables.get('lastReviewedBatchId') !== id || pm.collectionVariables.get('lastReviewCanReconcile') !== 'true' || !reason.trim() || reason.length > 500 || reason.includes(String.fromCharCode(0))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } else { pm.variables.set('reviewReasonJson', JSON.stringify(reason)); }

pm.test('Closure is audited and no longer eligible', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.duplicate).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(data.batch.accounting).to.eql('charged_reservation'); pm.expect(data.batch.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(data.batch.canReconcile).to.eql(false); pm.expect(data.batch.chargedMicroUsd).to.eql(data.batch.reservedMicroUsd); pm.expect(data.batch.reconciliation.resolution).to.eql('charge_reserved'); });
